description: Returns a 10 minute link to an official PDF: statutes, decisions, annual accounts (INPI RNE), a Sirene situation notice (INSEE) or a BODACC notice. Costs $0.0004 per document, paid from your balance (Authorization: Bearer) or with x402.

closing.description: Closing date of the accounts, for comptes

id.description: The registry PDF id for acte and bilan, the notice id for bodacc

kind.description: acte: statutes or decisions; bilan or comptes: annual accounts; avis-situation: the Sirene situation notice of an establishment; bodacc: a BODACC notice; marque, brevet, modele: the official INPI XML notice of a trademark (WIPO ST.66), a patent (ST.36) or a design (ST.86)

number.description: The FR title number without the country prefix, for marque, brevet and modele

type.description: Accounts type (C, S, K...), for comptes

name: get_document
title: Download a filed document
